Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

1,026 of 1,244 sentences in this record
Mr Alex Yam
Verdant smart mini-city estates

Describes a vision of green, smart, elderly-friendly estates in Punggol, Sengkang, Jurong Lake, Bidadari and Tengah.

  2. s00002 · budget-835Mr Alex Yam — Marsiling-Yew Tee

    A verdant oasis, and nestled within it, flats, public and private, with smart features – elderly-friendly, family-focused, well interconnected, with clean air with minimal vehicular traffic.

  3. s00003 · budget-835Mr Alex Yam — Marsiling-Yew Tee

    A city-state comprising other self-contained mini-cities, each a distinctive regional hub with their own commercial, business, social and educational facilities.

  5. s00005 · budget-835Mr Alex Yam — Marsiling-Yew Teecontext

    This is not a pipe dream; this is work-in-progress.

  6. s00006 · budget-835Mr Alex Yam — Marsiling-Yew Tee

    We already see signs of it in Punggol and Sengkang, also in the future developments for the Jurong Lake district, Bidadari and Tengah.

    Tax increase statements since 2013

    The Government says it has been deliberate and consistent since August 2013 in stating taxes must rise beyond this decade for spending needs.

    2. s00007 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      The first mention of the need for the tax increase was in the Prime Minister's National Day Rally in 2013, more than four years ago.

    3. s00008 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      The Minister for Finance reiterated this in his 2017 Budget Statement and again at a constituency function a few months later.

    4. s00009 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      The Prime Minister spoke again of the likelihood of a tax increase last November and had expressly referred to the Finance Minister's earlier statements.

    5. s00010 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      Indeed, in the previous term of Government, Deputy Prime Minister Tharman had said during the 2014 Budget Statement and in the 2015 Budget Statement that while the Government had taken steps to ensure that it had sufficient revenue to meet spending needs till the end of this decade, I quote, "we will run into structural deficits if we did not raise revenues in the next decade." As the Minister for Finance told Ms Lim in this House last Thursday, what Deputy Prime Minister Tharman said in 2014 and 2015 remains true today.

    6. s00011 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      The Government has enough money till the end of this decade but, beyond that, it would have to raise taxes to meet rising expenditure needs, especially in healthcare.

    7. s00012 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      The Government never floated test balloons on this matter.

    8. s00013 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      It has been deliberate and consistent in all its statements since August 2013.

    • Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
    Request to withdraw allegation

    A request is made for Ms Lim to withdraw her allegation about test balloons and GST and apologise by 8 March 2018.

    1. s00022 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yiencontext

      However, Parliamentary privilege does not entitle Members of Parliament to knowingly maintain allegations that have been shown to have no factual basis.

    2. s00023 · motion-830Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien

      Now that Ms Lim has been apprised of the facts, I request that she withdraw her allegation that the Government had floated test balloons on the need to raise revenues within this term and had intended to raise the GST immediately, and apologise to this House, before the end of this Sitting of Parliament on Thursday, 8 March 2018.
